resources.string: When a supported consent dialog appears, tap the floating button to start.
No activity in the current app session.
Sent a tap to open consent options.
Sent a tap to turn off an optional switch.
Rechecked an optional switch and observed it off. Vendor identity unverified.
Could not verify the switch state after the tap.
The Google consent panel moved or changed unexpectedly.
Could not account for every switch in the Google consent panel.
Android did not provide a readable image of the consent controls.
Could not verify that this switch turned off: %1$s.
All detected switches visually verified off: %1$s.
Data and vendor switches checked off. Confirmation sent.
Ready to confirm. Review the form, then tap Confirm choices in CookieRejecter.
The form was used after verification. Start again to recheck the choices.
Refusal stopped. Changes already made are still in the form.
Review needed. CookieRejecter could not finish checking the form.
Form left open. Open Vendor preferences to check vendor consent and legitimate-interest settings before confirming.
Refusal action sent. Saved choices and individual vendor settings are unverified.

Reads on-screen text to detect consent forms. After you tap the floating button, CookieRejecter may briefly inspect pixels in recognized Google forms to verify switch states, press refusal controls, and scroll. Processing stays on the device. Screenshots are discarded after each check.
Open Android Settings, then Accessibility, and enable CookieRejecter.
CookieRejecter checks optional switches and turns off the ones it can verify. Use Pause or Stop during the review.
When Ready to confirm appears, tap Confirm choices. Open Activity log to see what changed.
If switches are missed, try a longer wait.
Some switches could not be verified. Review them before confirming, or adjust Wait after scrolling in CookieRejecter and try again.
Some switches unverified. Try adjusting the scroll delay.
